cards.claim: Tim Martin is associated with American football.
cards.quote: Tim Martin (American football) Tim Martin (born April 12, 1976) is a former American football lineman who played eight seasons in the Arena Football League with the Oklahoma Wranglers, Dallas Desperados, New Orleans VooDoo, Grand Rapids Rampage and San Jose SaberCats.

cards.claim: Tim Martin is associated with cricket.
cards.quote: Tim Martin, a renowned figure in cricket, is known for his strategic insights and commentary on the sport.
